tasks.label: Build Java Project
args: $ErrorActionPreference=[System.Management.Automation.ActionPreference]::Stop; $files = Get-ChildItem -Path src -Filter *.java -Recurse | ForEach-Object { $_.FullName }; if (!(Test-Path bin)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path bin | Out-Null }; javac --release 8 -encoding UTF-8 -d bin $files

tasks.label: Generate Javadoc
args: $ErrorActionPreference=[System.Management.Automation.ActionPreference]::Stop; $files = Get-ChildItem -Path src -Filter *.java -Recurse | ForEach-Object { $_.FullName }; if (!(Test-Path javadoc)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path javadoc | Out-Null }; javadoc -source 8 -encoding UTF-8 -charset UTF-8 -Xdoclint:none -private -d javadoc $files
